evidence_slice: Gedling Borough Council's published Local Planning Document Policy LPD 64 lists H1 - Rolleston Drive as an allocated residential site for approximately 140 homes. The council's Local Planning Document housing-allocation open-data dataset is published through data.gov.uk with GeoJSON, OGC WFS, CSV, KML and ArcGIS GeoService resources; the current dataset metadata records Gedling Borough Council as publisher and a last-updated date of 7 June 2026.
binding_method: authority-owned multi-format open-data publication (GeoJSON/OGC WFS) plus exact adopted housing-allocation identifier; canonical parcel binding delegated to local OpenCode
